summary: Removes the hard-coded dashoffset=0 override so patches honor the dash tuple offset, matching Line2D behavior and correctly fixing the reported bug. Functionally correct; only cosmetic leftovers remain.

issues.description: The `cbook._setattr_cm(self, _dash_pattern=self._dash_pattern)` now sets the attribute to its own current value, making the context manager a no-op wrapper. Cleaner to drop the _dash_pattern override entirely and keep only `_bind_draw_path_function`. Harmless but dead structure.
Redundant parentheses in `(self._dash_pattern)` — should be plain `self._dash_pattern`. Pure style nit.

Old explanatory comment removed with no replacement noting the intentional behavior change; a brief note (or changelog/whatsnew entry) would help future maintainers understand the now-respected offset.
